title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 Business Analytics for AI spend, usage and value
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, preview access defaults, licensing requirements and documented controls are supported. The access-management route can be more complete, and the action rating should reflect the imminent preview with automatic access.
